name: Inbound Demo Request Routing
goal: Qualify demo requests, route qualified prospects to the right owner, and send booking instructions.

setup_notes: Connect the form or website source.
Confirm that calendar links exist for every possible owner.
Prepare one test request per routing path.

workflow_steps.name: Score and qualify the request
workflow_steps.instructions: Evaluate company size, work email, country, product interest, and urgency against the qualification rules.

workflow_steps.name: Route to the correct owner
workflow_steps.instructions: Use territory, segment, or round-robin rules to choose an owner and calendar link.

workflow_steps.name: Create or update CRM records
workflow_steps.instructions: Create or update the contact and deal, then write the owner, lifecycle stage, lead source, and requested product fields.

workflow_steps.name: Send prospect confirmation
workflow_steps.instructions: Send the approved email template with the assigned owner name and booking link.

workflow_steps.name: Notify the sales team
workflow_steps.instructions: Post the request details, qualification result, owner, SLA, and CRM link to the notification system.

workflow_steps.name: Create SLA task
workflow_steps.instructions: Create a follow-up task due within the configured SLA if the prospect has not booked.

manual_tests.name: Qualified enterprise request
manual_tests.input: A request that matches the highest-priority segment.
manual_tests.expected_result: Correct owner, CRM records, confirmation email, Slack alert, and SLA task are created.

manual_tests.name: Unqualified request
manual_tests.input: A request with a personal email and company size below the threshold.
manual_tests.expected_result: Workflow records the reason and sends the alternate message template if configured.

manual_tests.name: Missing calendar link
manual_tests.input: A request that routes to an owner without a calendar link.
manual_tests.expected_result: Workflow uses fallback owner or sends an error alert.

handoff_instructions: Confirm every owner has an active calendar link before launch.
Publish the SLA and routing rules to the sales team.
Audit owner assignment weekly for the first month.
